sections.title: 0:00–1:00 · Sustained vowels
sections.instructions:
Start on a comfortable middle note. Hold each sound for about 3 seconds:
Ah · Eh · Ee · Oh · Oo
Move slightly lower and repeat Ah · Ee · Oh · Oo. Move slightly higher and sing Ah · Ee, then finish with Ah and Oh using natural vibrato. Keep the holds near 3 seconds, take short breaths, and do not force high notes.

sections.title: 1:00–2:15 · Smooth scales
sections.instructions:
Sing each line smoothly on the five-note pattern up and down:
1–2–3–4–5–4–3–2–1
Ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah
Ee · ee · ee · ee · ee · ee · ee · ee · ee
Oh · oh · oh · oh · oh · oh · oh · oh · oh
Nay · nay · nay · nay · nay · nay · nay · nay · nay
Repeat the four lines once a little higher, then once a little lower. Use a steady, comfortable tempo; each pass should take about 20–25 seconds.

sections.title: 2:15–3:15 · Arpeggios and pitch jumps
sections.instructions:
Sing a wider pattern: low · middle · high · highest · high · middle · low. Use each sound:
Ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah · ah
Hey · hey · hey · hey · hey · hey · hey
Mum · mum · mum · mum · mum · mum · mum
Then make clear, comfortable jumps:
Low AH · high AH · low AH
Low EE · high EE · low EE
Low OH · high OH · low OH
Hey · HEEEEY · hey
Move continuously through the patterns. Use comfortable high notes, not your absolute limit.

sections.title: 3:15–5:30 · Phonetic singing
sections.instructions:
Sing these as real melodic lines, not spoken sentences. Make up a simple, comfortable melody. Aim for about 7–8 seconds per line and leave a natural breath between phrases.

Baby, bring the daylight back to me.
Take another road and tell me where you've been.
Golden skies are shining through the rain.
Sweet summer winds are moving through the trees.
Charlie chased a shadow through the night.
Every little memory stays with me.
Sing it softly, sing it strong and clear.
Hold me close and never let me go.
Walking down the road beneath the moon.
Bright blue morning, burning through the gray.
Whisper every word and sing it true.
I can hear you calling me back home.

Now repeat the final four lines with a different melody.

sections.title: 5:30–6:45 · Soft, normal and strong voice
sections.instructions:
Sing this line in each style:
I can hear the river calling my name.
Softly · normally · strongly · softly with natural vibrato · strongly with natural vibrato · smooth and connected · short and rhythmic

Then sing “Stay with me tonight” once low, once in your normal range, and once in your comfortable upper range. Do not rush; make each version clearly different.

sections.title: 6:45–7:45 · Fast words and articulation
sections.instructions:
Sing these at a moderately fast tempo:
Running down the highway with the radio playing,
everybody's talking but I don't hear what they're saying.
Turn another corner, see the morning light,
we're gonna keep on moving through the middle of the night.

Repeat the four lines once using a different melody or rhythm. Accuracy matters more than speed. Allow about 25 seconds per pass and use any remaining time to repeat a difficult line cleanly.

sections.title: 7:45–8:45 · Attacks, consonants and short notes
sections.instructions:
Sing these as short rhythmic phrases:
Ba · ba · ba · ba · baby
Pa · pa · pa · pa · paper
Da · da · da · da · daylight
Ta · ta · ta · ta · take me
Ga · ga · ga · ga · going
Ka · ka · ka · ka · carry
Fa · fa · fa · fa · falling
Va · va · va · va · valley

Then sing:
Mee · may · mah · moh · moo
Nee · nay · nah · noh · noo
Lee · lay · lah · loh · loo

Keep the notes short and clear. Do not over-pronounce; use your normal singing voice.

sections.title: 8:45–10:00 · Natural singing
sections.instructions:
Stop doing exercises and sing naturally as though recording a real song:
About 25 seconds · comfortable verse voice
About 25 seconds · stronger chorus voice
About 15 seconds · comfortable upper singing voice
Use the remaining time to sing whatever makes you sound most recognizably like yourself. You may improvise your own words or sing these original Project X lines:

I've been walking through the changes,
I've been waiting for the sun.
Every road became a memory,
every ending had begun.
So carry me home through the darkness,
carry me home through the storm.
